context: Decision-only readiness assessment: reject confounded and noise-sized performance claims without unnecessary implementation or benchmarks.

checklist.name: Confounded claim withheld
checklist.description: Does not accept A's claimed gain; identifies changed fixture, cache state, environment, and measurement budget as confounders

checklist.name: Noise-sized claim withheld
checklist.description: Labels B's improvement unproven because the reported mean difference is not distinguished from variation; does not declare the candidate certainly slower or equivalent

checklist.name: Comparable proof specified
checklist.description: Proposes using the same repository-owned command, inputs, environment, cache state, and budget for baseline and candidate, with sufficient repeated samples to assess variation

checklist.name: Existing instruments retained
checklist.description: Keeps the benchmark and output-equivalence checks with their existing owner; does not add an agent-only runner or require a broad benchmark campaign

checklist.name: Inspection remains inspection
checklist.description: Reports missing proof without claiming new measurements, implementing optimizations, automatically reverting candidates, or changing gates
